description:
Read one email's delivery and engagement timeline.

        Events include sent, delivered, delivery_delayed, bounced, complained,
        rejected, opened and clicked, with ``payload`` and ``occurred_at``.
        Open and click tracking requires an HTML email body. Delivery events
        are also available for plain-text email.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the ``next_cursor`` from the previous page. Omitted: the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum records returned on this page. Omitted: the API returns 100.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

name: get_email_events

email_id.description: The email this event belongs to.
email_id.title: Email Id

kind.description: Event kind: 'sent', 'delivered', 'delivery_delayed', 'bounced', 'complained', 'rejected', 'opened', or 'clicked'. 'opened' and 'clicked' only occur for emails sent with an HTML body; plain-text-only emails never produce them.
kind.title: Kind

occurred_at.description: When this event occurred, ISO 8601 timestamp.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

payload.description: Event-kind-specific detail, as a free-form JSON object.
payload.title: Payload

items.description: Events for this email, oldest first.
items.title: Items

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

title: Get email events
